text:
Rina: Heads-up: partner showcase next month. request from Datadog PMs: a compact 'observability bridge' demo that shows our traces -> OTLP -> Datadog flow plus a marketplace tile screenshot. can we assemble a repeatable kit?
Theo: i like a 3-file kit: dashboard.json, otel-config.yaml, and a short runbook.md. keeps SI handoff friction low.
Leah: GTM note: include 2 talking points: (1) how trace enrichment helps debug model regressions, (2) how cost tags let teams compare runtime vs quantized variants.
Omar: for hardware partners we should also show a private deployment path (air-gapped with export bundle). short snippet for proxy-forwarding is enough.
Sam (eng): i'll build the minimal OTEL example and a tiny Node demo app that emits spans for model requests. snippet below for exporter config:
```yaml
exporters:
  otlp/datadog:
    endpoint: "https://otlp.datadoghq.com:4317"
    headers:
      DD_API_KEY: "<REDACTED>"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      exporters: [otlp/datadog]
```
Sam (eng): runtime flag for enrichment: REDWOOD_TRACE_ENRICH=true (adds model, model_version tags).
Rina: include a note about cardinality: recommend sampling prompt_id at 1% by default. SIs can increase for trouble tickets.
Theo: dashboard widgets: p95 latency by model tag, token-cost trend, trace flamegraph filtered by error tag. keep the JSON export small.
Leah: marketplace copy: one short sentence + callout about enterprise controls (VPC, KMS). i'll draft.
Omar: for onprem customers show a file-buffer fallback mode: config snippet -> buffer to /var/log/rdw-buffer if DD unreachable, then forward. small runbook step for ops.
Datadog-bot: preflight-check: OTLP endpoint reachable from staging cluster - OK
Sam (eng): adding TLS cert note for proxy customers: set OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_CERT=/etc/otel/certs/ca.pem in env.
Rina: timeline proposal:
- Fri EOD: first drafts of dashboard + otel snippet (Sam, Theo)
- Mon AM: dry-run demo video (Sam, Rina)
- Mon PM: marketplace tile and blurb (Leah)
- Tue: package + SI handoff (Omar)
Leah: i'll prepare the blurb and a 2-line FAQ about PII and retention.
Theo: i'll make the dashboard and export a reduced JSON.
Sam (eng): demo app pushed to the shared repo, will link once CI finishes.
Rina: thanks all. i'll create the partner repo and add a checklist. meeting to review Monday 9am PT. :calendar:
